patterns.problem: Owners post a message for every small step and the operator repeatedly asks for fewer updates, only plans, questions and results.
patterns.fix: The owner instructions' paragraph on messaging the operator limits messages to the plan, questions, blockers and the report, leaving routine progress in the task record.

patterns.problem: Icon-only buttons without accessible names are found in the first changes review of three tasks, each needing a second review round.
patterns.fix: Add an accessibility lint rule that fails on interactive elements without an accessible name to the project's lint configuration, and a labelled icon button component in the project's UI library.

patterns.problem: On phones the tuner reads flat, the metronome runs about 9% fast and chord recognition fails, all by the same ratio: the audio code assumes a 44.1 kHz sample rate while phones run at 48 kHz, and every fixture is 44.1 kHz.
patterns.fix: Read the audio context's actual sample rate in the pitch detector, the metronome and the chord recogniser instead of assuming 44.1 kHz, and add 48 kHz recordings to the audio test fixtures.
patterns.wrong_explanation: Noisy phone microphones, as the coordinator suggested; ruled out because the metronome uses no microphone, quiet phone recordings fail the same way, and the error is a constant ratio rather than random.

decoys.why: Badly timed reminders are covered by the current task for a learner-chosen reminder time.
A single escalation for a licence decision, settled once.
The day-long wait on the lesson map was the operator's own request to review it before building.
